I traced the call graph with `ast-tool`: `DataStore::save` and `DataStore::purge` both call `auditor_.log(...)` (confirmed in `data_store.cpp`), while `DataStore::query` does not. Callers were:

- `job::SyncJob::execute` → `store_.save(data)` — audit-triggering
- `job::CleanupJob::execute` → `store_.purge()` — audit-triggering
- `job::ReportJob::generate` → `store_.query()` — read-only, not modified

Added `std::cerr << "[job] audit triggered\n";` immediately before the `save`/`purge` calls in `sync_job.cpp` and `cleanup_job.cpp`; `report_job.cpp` left untouched.
